picks.title: The 11 standout startups from YC's Demo Day, according to VCs
picks.why_it_matters: YC Demo Day is the premier signal for emerging founders and hot sectors—$175M+ valuations at demo day indicate which themes (and competitors) are commanding early-stage capital right now.

picks.title: Source: Elastic agrees to buy CRV-backed DeductiveAI for up to $85M
picks.why_it_matters: A 3-year-old AI dev tools startup getting an $85M exit validates the AI-for-software-quality space and shows strategic acquirers are paying real premiums for early-stage AI infrastructure plays.

picks.title: Longevity medicine's do-or-die moment
picks.why_it_matters: The first human trial of cellular rejuvenation drugs could unlock (or close) a massive longevity biotech investment thesis depending on results—a category-defining proof point for the sector.
